question: Does the P0574 symmetry-gated baryon-only map make held-out spectroscopic multiple images map back to a more consistent source position than local baryon light?

raw_data.source: Caminha et al. 2022, A&A 666 L9, arXiv:2207.07567v3, Table 1
raw_data.selection: Use only the four pre-JWST families with exact spectroscopic redshifts: 1, 2, 5, and 19; three images per family, 12 positions total.
raw_data.excluded: Families 3 and 4 have lens-model redshifts; every dagger-marked family was discovered with JWST and is outside the pre-JWST replication target.

split.selection_reason: First two spectroscopic families calibrate one positive global deflection amplitude; the other two spectroscopic families test transfer with no amplitude or source-position refit beyond each family's analytic mean source position.

models.null_no_lens: Observed image positions with amplitude zero.
models.local_control: The 100 kpc F160W member-light map used in P0573-P0574.
models.p0573_no_gate: The frozen 50 kpc, f=0.8 tidal-weighted arrival map.
models.p0574_symmetry_gated: The selected 60 kpc, f=0.8, Q0=0.05, n=4 quarter-turn-gated arrival map.
models.lenstool_map_reference: The processed mean of 100 standard Lenstool convergence maps, evaluated through the same numerical potential solver and one-amplitude source-plane statistic.

lensing_equation.potential: laplacian(psi)=2*Sigma_map, alpha_map=grad(psi), solved on a two-times zero-padded grid
lensing_equation.amplitude_fit: For each model separately, fit one nonnegative A on families 1 and 2 by analytic least squares after subtracting each family's mean beta; hold A fixed for families 5 and 19.
lensing_equation.metric: RMS separation in arcseconds of inferred source positions from their family mean; this is source-plane scatter, not image-plane RMS.
lensing_equation.nuisance_parameters: One amplitude per compared map and one analytic two-coordinate family mean; no halo, shear, ellipticity, core radius, or per-family deflection amplitude.

published_context.standard_model: The paper's full pre-JWST Lenstool model used a cluster halo, 61 member halos, external shear, ten mass parameters, and two free source redshifts.
published_context.comparison_limit: The published 0.39 arcsec image-plane RMS is not numerically comparable to this source-plane scatter. It is recorded only as the standard-model context.

claim_limits: The P0573 convergence target was reconstructed from overlapping HST strong-lensing information, so these positions are rawer but not statistically independent of the formula-selection history.
A fitted normalized-map amplitude does not predict absolute gravity strength or a universal stellar mass-to-light ratio.
Source-plane scatter can bias model comparisons differently from full image-plane root finding near critical curves.
Only one cluster and four nearly similar source redshifts are tested.
The baryon map still omits hot gas, intracluster light, and stellar mass-to-light variation.
The Lenstool reference here is a processed convergence map, not a reproduction of the paper's ten-parameter image-plane optimization.
